rows.details: District Agriculture Office, Deoghar – Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative Department (Agriculture Division), Government of Jharkhand
Matric / 10th pass and a minimum 5-day training under the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture
18 years minimum; maximum varies by category, as on 01/11/2026
Plant Protection Centres in six blocks of Deoghar district, Jharkhand
Application must be received by 08.12.2026, 5:00 PM

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The District Agriculture Office, Deoghar is a district office of the Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative Department (Agriculture Division), Government of Jharkhand, headed by the District Agriculture Officer, Deoghar. These posts are under the Crop Protection Programme (फसल सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम) for the financial year 2026-27. According to the notice, the aim is to carry out crop protection and plant protection work effectively at the local level.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by post. The application address printed in the notice is: Office, District Agriculture Officer, Deoghar, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, Chandpur, Dabargram, Jasidih, Deoghar - 814112. Use the application form (Vigyapan-sah-Vivarnika) printed with the notice. The form is also available on the Deoghar district website deoghar.nic.in and on atmadeoghar.co.in, and on the notice board of the District Agriculture Office, Deoghar. Fill every column clearly and completely in your own handwriting and mark choices with a tick (✓). Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph in the box on the form. In column 21, list your preferred blocks for posting in order (up to six). Sign the declaration and attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Enclosures, in the order given. Seal the form and documents in an envelope of 12 x 9 inch / A4 size. On the envelope write "मानदेय / परिश्रमिक आधारित फसल रक्षक (कामदार) हेतु आवेदन" (Application for honorarium-based Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar)), the block name, and your name and address. Send it by Speed Post / Registered Post so that it reaches the office by 5:00 PM on 8 December 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted. An application without the self-attested copies of the required certificates will be treated as incomplete.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post per Plant Protection Centre, 6 in total. The category-wise break-up follows the model reservation roster for Deoghar district. Minimum Matric / Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised educational institution. Minimum one 5-day training received under the Directorate of Agriculture or Directorate of Horticulture of the Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative Department, Government of Jharkhand. Knowledge of the local language. Ability to ride a bicycle and to climb trees. Local applicants of the block whose centre is advertised will be given preference. All candidates must submit a valid Jharkhand local resident certificate issued by the competent authority; candidates claiming reservation must submit a valid caste / category certificate in the prescribed format. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The minimum age is 18 years. Age is counted as on 1 November 2026, and only the date of birth recorded in the Matric marksheet / certificate is accepted. Monthly honorarium / remuneration: Rs. 11851/-. Nature of post: honorarium / remuneration based. Period of appointment: 11 months (or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier). No claim to regular appointment or permanence will be accepted, and there is no automatic right to service benefits equal to regular government employees.

content_sections.heading: District Agriculture Office Deoghar Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar) Job Description
content_sections.text: Spraying of pesticides. Awareness / training among farmers. Other work allotted by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following must be attached to the application: Matric / 10th certificate and marksheet (the Matric certificate is also the proof of date of birth). Minimum 5-day training certificate. Local language certificate, if available. Valid local resident certificate issued by the competent authority. Caste certificate, where applicable. Identity card / copy of photo identity card (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving Licence / PAN Card). Copy of Aadhaar Card (clearly visible). A character / conduct certificate need not be attached to the application, but must be submitted at final selection / document verification / joining, in the format set by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be scrutinised against the prescribed eligibility and required documents. Applications missing required details or certificates, not meeting the essential qualification, or giving false / misleading information will be rejected. Selection will be done under the supervision of a selection committee formed by the competent authority. Where marks are in CGPA / grade, the percentage will be worked out by the conversion formula of the board concerned. No extra marks for Intermediate or any higher qualification, and no extra marks for more than one degree / qualification of the same level. Training duration is counted by the full training days clearly stated in the certificate; only training certificates issued by the Directorates of Agriculture and Horticulture under the Agriculture Department are valid. A skill test in cycling and tree climbing will be held at Krishi Vigyan Kendra Sujani, Deoghar. Original certificates of selected / provisionally selected candidates will be verified before final selection, on a date fixed later. If candidates' marks are equal, Matric percentage decides; if that is also equal, the older candidate (by date of birth) gets preference. A category-wise merit list will be prepared as per the reservation rules. Plant Protection Centres will be allotted giving priority to the residence block shown in the local resident certificate and to the preferences in the form; the final decision may be taken by the District Agriculture Officer, Deoghar on administrative grounds and may be changed later. The preference given in the form is not a right to a particular allotment.

faq.question: Q1. How many Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar) vacancies are there in Deoghar?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts, one at each Plant Protection Centre in the Deoghar, Sarwan, Mohanpur, Sarath, Madhupur and Palojori blocks: UR 3, SC 1, BC-I 1 and BC-II 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications can be sent from 23 November 2026 and must reach the District Agriculture Office, Deoghar by 5:00 PM on 8 December 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar)?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least Matric / 10th pass from a recognised institution and a minimum 5-day training under the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture, Jharkhand. Knowledge of the local language and the ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees are also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years; the maximum is 37 years for UR, 42 years for SC and 40 years for BC-I and BC-II, counted as on 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar)?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium / remuneration is Rs. 11851/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the application form by hand, attach self-attested certificate copies and send it in a 12 x 9 inch / A4 envelope by Speed Post / Registered Post to Office, District Agriculture Officer, Deoghar, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, Chandpur, Dabargram, Jasidih, Deoghar - 814112.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "मानदेय / परिश्रमिक आधारित फसल रक्षक (कामदार) हेतु आवेदन", the block name, and your name and address.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised for eligibility and documents, a cycling and tree-climbing skill test is held at Krishi Vigyan Kendra Sujani, Deoghar, original certificates are verified, and a category-wise merit list is prepared. Ties are broken by Matric percentage, then by higher age.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an honorarium-based temporary appointment for 11 months or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier, with no claim to regularisation or permanence.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference for a block?
faq.answer: Local applicants of the block whose centre is advertised get preference. Centres are allotted by the residence block in the local resident certificate and the preferences in the form, with the final decision by the District Agriculture Officer, Deoghar.
